name: @tank/slack-message-writer
description: Write concise, smartly formatted Slack messages and automatically copy the final text to the macOS clipboard. Covers composer markup, API mrkdwn, Markdown blocks, special mentions, localized dates, accessibility, announcements, status and incident updates, decisions, handoffs, and review requests. Triggers: write a Slack message, draft a Slack message, Slack copy, copy to clipboard, Slack announcement, Slack update, Slack incident, Slack review request, format for Slack, make Slack-ready.
